messages.text:
https://chaos-tarot.com/ie

And everything you know about our Infinite Labyrinth and Labyrinth of Apockalypse projects.

Review this project and I want you to formulate a prompt I can feed into Gemini to get a v9 proposal from a different perspective, something that accomplishes the GOALS and what we want from LoA and the Infinity Engine but without copying what we've already tried, I want a radically novel approach the next iteration and evolution of a whole ass game engine built purely on maths and systems running the hardware to the best of its ability and thinking outside the box in terms of simulation and dimensionality. Our current substrate is 4D but what about even MORE spacial dimensions? Is rust even still the best language based on everything we've learned from all 8 versions of the substrate? I want to find out and I want another perspective from Google Gemini.

This is a clear and detailed ask — I know your stack intimately across all the iterations. Let me pull in the current state of the Infinity Engine page and any public-facing context, then I'll synthesize everything into a prompt that gives Gemini the full picture while pushing it toward genuinely alien territory.

Kicking off research now.

https://chaos-tarot.com/ie

And everything you know about our Infinite Labyrinth and Labyrinth of Apockalypse projects.

Review this project and I want you to formulate a prompt I can feed into Gemini to get a v9 proposal from a different perspective, something that accomplishes the GOALS and what we want from LoA and the Infinity Engine but without copying what we've already tried, I want a radically novel approach the next iteration and evolution of a whole ass game engine built purely on maths and systems running the hardware to the best of its ability and thinking outside the box in terms of simulation and dimensionality. Our current substrate is 4D but what about even MORE spacial dimensions? Is rust even still the best language based on everything we've learned from all 8 versions of the substrate? I want to find out and I want another perspective from Google Gemini.

I am pasting this again because I thought of something else, what about low level languages to really take control from the foundation up? Like how roller coaster tycoon was built in Assembly?

Really think outside the box for the best solution for this new perfect game engine.

Great addition — the RollerCoaster Tycoon precedent is exactly the kind of thinking that should be on the table. Chris Sawyer proved that a single developer with total hardware mastery can outperform entire studios. Let me launch a supplementary deep dive on that angle specifically.

Your game engine architecture research report is ready. It covers the lessons from Chris Sawyer's RollerCoaster Tycoon approach reinterpreted for modern hardware, language comparisons across Odin, Zig, and C, GPU-first compute-driven rendering pipelines, Projective Geometric Algebra as a unified math framework, 4D SDF world representation, cellular automata and Lattice Boltzmann physics, and hardware optimization strategies. The report concludes with a concrete v9 architecture synthesis combining these components into a coherent radical engine design for a solo developer.
